data.body: debug-everything 2026-05-08: Classification: llm-behavioral. Applied minimal targeted fix per reporter suggestion: added MANDATORY breadcrumb directive at COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md Step 0 making per-step echo writes explicitly required (not advisory). Treats empty breadcrumb log + successful commit as a workflow violation. Reporter's deeper suggestions (#1 move writes into helper scripts, #2 validation-gate check on start+end events) remain valid follow-ups requiring larger refactors and are NOT addressed by this minimal edit.
